en: Black‑and‑white image showing a landscaped park or garden with lawns and shrubs in the foreground and a long, ornate wooden pavilion or spa building in the center-right. The structure has a covered veranda with many arches and a gabled central section with decorative trim. Behind it are wooded hills and additional chalet-style buildings, suggesting a mountainous or forested resort area. The architecture appears Central European, likely from the early 20th century.
